fields.name: name
fields.description: Model family name, e.g. conn-demo. Together with version, identifies the bundle in Prediction.modelName/modelVersion

fields.name: version
fields.description: Model version within its family, e.g. v1

fields.name: schemaId
fields.description: Feature schema id this model was trained against, e.g. conn-feature-v1. Must resolve in FeatureSchemaRegistry

fields.name: schemaHash
fields.description: SHA-256 content hash of that feature schema, 64 lowercase hex characters, matching the registered schema's own content hash. A scoring component compares this against the live registry so a model cannot silently score a feature schema that has drifted since training

fields.name: featureOrder
fields.description: Feature names in the exact order the model expects them, for a human/CI cross-check against the registered schema's own ordering. This is documentation for that check; the runtime feature order always comes from the registered schema, never from this list

fields.name: classes
fields.description: Human-readable class labels, e.g. ["normal", "attack"]. positiveClassColumn does NOT index into this list -- see positiveClassColumn below

fields.name: threshold
fields.description: Decision cutoff in [0.0, 1.0]: a score at or above this value is a positive decision. Carried into ModelRef.threshold and, per-prediction, into Prediction.threshold

fields.name: modelSha
fields.description: SHA-256 of model.onnx's raw bytes, 64 lowercase hex characters. FilesystemModelRegistry recomputes this at load time and refuses to load the bundle if model.onnx does not match -- a truncated or swapped model file must never reach the runtime silently

fields.name: outputName
fields.description: Name of the ONNX graph's output tensor that carries the class probabilities

fields.name: positiveClassColumn
fields.description: The COLUMN of the output tensor named by outputName that carries P(positive class) -- it is not an index into classes. 0 for a single-column probability graph (this bundle format's own fixture), 1 for a scikit-learn probability output exported with zipmap=False, which emits one column per class in class order

fields.name: metrics
fields.description: Free-form training metrics (e.g. precision, recall, AUC). Opaque to the runtime; for humans and future dashboards only. {} is valid

fields.name: trainedAt
fields.description: When the model was trained, ISO-8601 UTC

fields.name: provenance
fields.description: Free-text description of how the model was produced: training data, converter (e.g. skl2onnx) version, and any other detail needed to reproduce it

fields.name: sampleVectors
fields.description: Golden vectors: real feature vectors paired with the probability scikit-learn produced for each, each an object with values (array<float32>, one value per entry in featureOrder) and expectedScore (float64). A test feeds these through the ONNX runtime and asserts agreement within a small tolerance -- the guard against a converter changing semantics between training and serving, which no other check in this pipeline would notice
